contexts.text: Emim, Rephaim, Anakim, Zamzummim () = those who are imbued with persuasions of evil and falsity.

That every Church in process of time decreases, until it has nothing of faith and charity left, and that it is then destroyed, was represented by Kirjath Arba which is Hebron being possessed by Anakim, by whom are signified direful persuasions of falsity. Illustrated.
